subject: Decision Making
title: Delphi Method
description: A quick, practical guide to Delphi Method.

hook.text: The Delphi method collects expert opinions in multiple anonymous rounds.

buildup.text: RAND Corporation developed it in the 1950s to forecast Soviet military capabilities without group pressure distorting.

discovery.text: Anonymity prevents status from dominating. Iteration allows learning.

twist.text: Delphi works best for uncertain forecasts. For questions with clear data, it adds bureaucracy without adding accuracy.

climax.text: Delphi structures crowd wisdom for experts. Anonymity, feedback.

punchline.text: Anonymous estimates, multiple rounds. Delphi protects wisdom from group.

quiz.question: Why is anonymity important in the Delphi method?
options: It prevents status and social pressure from distorting individual expert judgment
